# uptimekuma_monitor_sftp (Resource)

SFTP monitor resource. The monitor opens an SSH connection to a host, authenticates with a password or a private key and, when `sftp_path` is set, checks that the remote path exists. Requires Uptime Kuma 2.5.4 or later.

`port`, `ssh_password`, `ssh_private_key`, `ssh_passphrase` and `sftp_path` are stored as SQL NULL while unset, which is a different state from setting them to the value the check falls back to. Leave them unset to follow the check's own fallbacks.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# SFTP Monitor Resource Example

# Password authentication. Leaving port unset stores it as SQL NULL, which tells
# the check to fall back to port 22; setting port = 22 is a different state, so
# prefer leaving it out.
resource "uptimekuma_monitor_sftp" "password" {
  name         = "Backup SFTP"
  hostname     = "sftp.example.com"
  ssh_username = "backup"
  ssh_password = var.sftp_password
}

# Private key authentication, additionally checking that a remote path exists
resource "uptimekuma_monitor_sftp" "private_key" {
  name        = "Deploy SFTP"
  description = "Upload target of the release pipeline"
  hostname    = "files.example.com"
  port        = 2222
  timeout     = 15

  ssh_username    = "deploy"
  ssh_auth_method = "privateKey"
  ssh_private_key = file("${path.module}/id_ed25519")
  ssh_passphrase  = var.sftp_key_passphrase

  # While set, the check also verifies that this path exists on the server.
  sftp_path = "/srv/releases"

  interval        = 300
  retry_interval  = 120
  resend_interval = 10
  max_retries     = 5
  active          = true
  upside_down     = false

  notification_ids = [1, 2]

  tags = [
    {
      tag_id = 1
      value  = "production"
    }
  ]
}

variable "sftp_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

variable "sftp_key_passphrase" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

# Requires Terraform or OpenTofu 1.11 or later: ssh_private_key_wo is never stored in
# plan or state. Change ssh_private_key_wo_version whenever the secret changes.
resource "uptimekuma_monitor_sftp" "write_only" {
  name = "SFTP monitor with a write-only private key"

  hostname        = "sftp.example.com"
  ssh_username    = "backup"
  ssh_auth_method = "privateKey"

  ssh_private_key_wo         = file("~/.ssh/id_ed25519")
  ssh_private_key_wo_version = "1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `hostname` (String) SFTP server IP address or hostname
- `name` (String) Friendly name
- `ssh_username` (String) User to authenticate as

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `active` (Boolean) Monitor is active
- `description` (String) Description
- `interval` (Number) Heartbeat interval in seconds. Minimum 20. Uptime Kuma 2.5.0 removed the former 24 day maximum, so no upper bound is enforced.
- `max_retries` (Number) Maximum number of retries
- `notification_ids` (List of Number) List of notification IDs
- `parent` (Number) Parent monitor ID for hierarchical organization
- `port` (Number) TCP port of the SFTP server, between 1 and 65535. While unset, the check falls back to 22.
- `resend_interval` (Number) Resend interval in seconds
- `retry_interval` (Number) Retry interval in seconds. Minimum 20, and like `interval` it has no upper bound since Uptime Kuma 2.5.0.
- `sftp_path` (String) Remote path that must exist on the server. While unset, the check only verifies that the SSH connection and authentication succeed.
- `ssh_auth_method` (String) SSH authentication method, either `password` or `privateKey`. Defaults to `password`. `privateKey` requires `ssh_private_key`.
- `ssh_passphrase` (String, Sensitive) Passphrase of `ssh_private_key`. Only allowed while `ssh_auth_method` is `privateKey`, because password authentication ignores it. Stored in state; use `ssh_passphrase_wo` to keep it out of state.
- `ssh_passphrase_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Passphrase of the private key, write-only: sent to Uptime Kuma on create and update but never stored in plan or state. Requires Terraform 1.11 or OpenTofu 1.11 or later. Conflicts with `ssh_passphrase`; requires `ssh_passphrase_wo_version`. An imported resource has no `ssh_passphrase_wo_version` yet, so `terraform import` may store the server's value in `ssh_passphrase` until the next apply with `ssh_passphrase_wo` set removes it from state.
- `ssh_passphrase_wo_version` (String) Any value that changes whenever `ssh_passphrase_wo` changes, for example a counter or a hash of the secret's encrypted source. A change triggers an update that sends the current `ssh_passphrase_wo`.
- `ssh_password` (String, Sensitive) Password for SSH authentication. Only allowed while `ssh_auth_method` is `password`, because key authentication ignores it. Stored in state; use `ssh_password_wo` to keep it out of state.
- `ssh_password_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Password for SSH authentication, write-only: sent to Uptime Kuma on create and update but never stored in plan or state. Requires Terraform 1.11 or OpenTofu 1.11 or later. Conflicts with `ssh_password`; requires `ssh_password_wo_version`. An imported resource has no `ssh_password_wo_version` yet, so `terraform import` may store the server's value in `ssh_password` until the next apply with `ssh_password_wo` set removes it from state.
- `ssh_password_wo_version` (String) Any value that changes whenever `ssh_password_wo` changes, for example a counter or a hash of the secret's encrypted source. A change triggers an update that sends the current `ssh_password_wo`.
- `ssh_private_key` (String, Sensitive) Private key in PEM or OpenSSH format. Required while `ssh_auth_method` is `privateKey` and not allowed otherwise, because password authentication ignores it. Stored in state; use `ssh_private_key_wo` to keep it out of state.
- `ssh_private_key_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Private key in PEM or OpenSSH format, write-only: sent to Uptime Kuma on create and update but never stored in plan or state. Requires Terraform 1.11 or OpenTofu 1.11 or later. Conflicts with `ssh_private_key`; requires `ssh_private_key_wo_version`. An imported resource has no `ssh_private_key_wo_version` yet, so `terraform import` may store the server's value in `ssh_private_key` until the next apply with `ssh_private_key_wo` set removes it from state.
- `ssh_private_key_wo_version` (String) Any value that changes whenever `ssh_private_key_wo` changes, for example a counter or a hash of the secret's encrypted source. A change triggers an update that sends the current `ssh_private_key_wo`.
- `tags` (Attributes Set) Set of tags assigned to this monitor (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
- `timeout` (Number) Connection timeout in seconds, at least 0.1, used as both the SSH ready timeout and the socket timeout. Fractional values are supported and round-trip unchanged. Defaults to 10. Note that the Uptime Kuma web UI assigns 48 to new monitors, so a monitor created there and then imported reports 48. The floor exists because the check treats 0 or less as no timeout being set and uses 10 instead, while the stored value would still read back as set. The server enforces no upper bound, but saving the monitor in the web UI clamps the value to 80% of `interval`, so a monitor edited there afterwards can come back lowered.
- `upside_down` (Boolean) Invert monitor status (treat DOWN as UP and vice versa)

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Monitor identifier
